replace_if_match_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string based on a condition. It checks if the substring matches a specific pattern in the full string, and if it does, replaces it with another substring. It then splits the full string by a delimiter.

replace_concat_with_cdr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $2)))))))
description: A function that replaces the concatenation of two substrings in a full string with the rest of the string after splitting by a delimiter.

replace_vowels_with_specific_substring :: tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (replace_if_match_split $0 $1 (regex_or 'a' (regex_or 'o' (regex_or 'e' (regex_or 'i' 'u')))))))
description: A function that replaces vowels in a full string with a specific substring based on a given condition. It checks for vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') in the full string and replaces them with the specified substring.

replace_end_of_string :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with a specified substring. It appends the given substring to the end of the string after splitting by a delimiter.

replace_substring_based_on_condition :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: A function that replaces substrings in a full string based on a condition provided by a transformation function. It splits the full string by a delimiter and applies the transformation function to each substring, replacing it with the result of the transformation.

append_substring_to_end :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that appends a specified substring to the end of a full string.

replace_end_of_string_with_reversed_substring :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split empty_string $2))))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with a reversed substring. It concatenates the first two substrings, reverses the third substring, and appends it to the concatenated result.

replace_p_with_given_substring :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match 'p' $0) $1 $0)) (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that replaces occurrences of the letter 'p' in a full string with a specified substring. It splits the full string by an empty string and applies the replacement based on the given condition.

replace_first_letter_with_rest_after_dot :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons $0 (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the first letter of a full string with the rest of the string after splitting by a dot.

replace_specific_letter_with_concatenated_letter :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match_split $0 (regex_concat 'a' $1) $2))))
description: A function that replaces a specific letter in a full string with a concatenated letter based on a condition. It checks for the presence of the specified letter in the full string and if found, replaces it with the concatenation of 'a' and another specified letter.
